Maya: EdgeWave (HW partner) asked for a single evidence digest for marketplace upload: redacted SOC2, SOC summary, pen-test pointer, firmware attestation, artifact->owner CSV. Can we agree format/owners? :wave:
Raj: Security: redacted SOC2 PDF + 1-paragraph summary + pen-test with CVE IDs. Need redaction checklist and TTL for presigned links.
Leo: Firmware attest should include signing key id, algorithm, and audit-trail reference. CSV ok; add notes column for extra metadata.
Nina: SI teams prefer CSV/XLSX. Suggest cols: artifact_type,filename,sensitivity,redacted,owner,contact,storage_path,presign_url,expires_at,proof_of_origin,consent_url,notes.
Maya: Example row (short): SOC2,redacted_soc2_2025.pdf,confidential,true,security,sec@redwood.ai,s3://partners/edgewave/soc2,https://presign/xxx,2025-12-31,s3://vault/v1,https://legal/nda,"redacted customer IDs"
Sofia: Legal will review attestation language and consent_url. If pen includes undisclosed CVEs, require NDA before full access.
Raj: SOC summary: "SOC2 Type II covering storage & change control (2024-07 to 2025-07). Shared file redacted; full report available under NDA (sec@redwood.ai)."
DevOpsBot: Presign job queued (ps-10011). ETA 2025-11-18T10:00Z.
AuditorBot: Reminder: retain originals in secure-vault for 2 years per policy.
Leo: I'll add a small script to generate the CSV and call presign API; will emit presign_url + expires_at columns.
Nina: I'll schedule a 15-min sync with EdgeWave to confirm format & retention. Tue 2025-11-19 15:00 PT proposed.
Maya: Action items: Raj(redactions+summary), Leo(script+firmware meta), Sofia(legal attestation), Nina(schedule+partner call), Maya(assemble CSV + trigger presigns). I'll follow up after sync. :thumbsup:
